chunks: He reviewed the birds and said: 'Why is it I do not see the Hud-hud? Or was he among those absent?'
ai.seo_question: Why did Prophet Sulaiman ask about the absence of the Hud-hud?
ai.summary: In this verse, Prophet Sulaiman (AS) inquires about the absence of the hoopoe, using the term 'gha'ibin' which Shia exegetes often interpret as either a temporary delay or a specific category of those who were absent from his court. This moment highlights the Prophet's attentiveness to detail and his expectation of accountability from his servants, setting the stage for the bird's report on the Queen of Sheba. The phrasing suggests a gentle inquiry rather than immediate rebuke, reflecting the prophetic character of patience and observation.
